def intersection(nums1, nums2):
    return list(set(nums1) & set(nums2))

negate:
    mov rax, rdi
    neg rax
    ret

climb_stairs:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rcx, 1
.loop:
    cmp rdi, 1
    jle .done
    mov rdx, rax

to_lower:
    xor rax, rax
.loop:
    mov cl, [rdi + rax]
    test cl, cl
    je .done
    cmp cl, 'A'
